title: Stylized Water
description: A stylized water shader: animated waves, foam, sparkles and refraction around floating objects under a cloudy sky. Selim Anaç's Defold port of Daniel Shervheim's Unity stylized water.
author: Selim Anaç (selimanac)
credits: Original Unity implementation by Daniel Shervheim (danielshervheim/unity-stylized-water).
notes: extension-imgui is a dependency the sample never calls (no imgui.* in its Lua); its C++ does not compile against Defold 1.14, so it is left out of the cart engine.
WebGPU: patches/ samples the foam and sparkle textures before the per-pixel distance tests that pick among them (WGSL samples only in uniform control flow); the result is the same.
